title: Global Robust High-Back Multi-Tilter Chair — 500 lb Capacity
body_html:
Built to carry an active user up to 500 lbs without ever feeling like a compromise on comfort.

The Global Robust High-Back Multi-Tilter pairs a heavy-duty steel frame, pneumatic cylinder, and 32" six-prong base with an Ultracell high-density foam seat and an integrated headrest for full neck and shoulder support. Width-adjustable steel loop arms, seated-position tension control, and 3" casters rated to 225 lbs each make it a true workhorse. Tested beyond ANSI/BIFMA standards and made in Canada.

Key features

  • Heavy-duty pneumatic cylinder, mechanism and frame engineered for an active user weight up to 500 lbs
  • Width-adjustable solid steel loop arms — 1.5" per side; vinyl-dipped to stay warm to the touch and absorb impact
  • Side tension adjustment reachable from a seated position
  • Ultracell high-density, high-resilient foam seat with a 3" wide back support upright for extra strength
  • 32" diameter six-prong oval tubular steel base with 3" casters rated to 225 lbs each
  • Heavy-duty double-wall packaging with interior wood pallet and four nylon straps for safe transit

Who it’s for

Healthcare facilities, municipal offices, and institutional settings that need durable bariatric-rated seating for multi-shift or higher-weight users.

Office Central and Brant Business Interiors are verified OECM partners, so Ontario’s public sector can buy without an open tender. Call 1-800-835-9565 for a quote.
